description: This file defines a JavaScript module for creating time series charts using d3 and metrics-graphics, specifically within the 'd3.goteo' namespace. It includes a function 'timemetricsChart' that generates configurable time series visualizations.

methods.name: timemetricsChart
methods.description: Creates a configurable time series chart generator function that uses metrics-graphics and d3 to visualize data with options for title, description, date range, and formatting.
